split_note: Bio plus cutoff: fallback as tools or as staffed corps.

situation.title: Biological Incident
situation.description: A real biological incident with model involvement: a deliberate release or a laboratory escape involving a designed or modified agent. Casualties are real, containment runs for weeks, and every argument about AI risk in every jurisdiction is reset by it.

situation.title: Capability Jump
situation.description: A discontinuous advance is released or demonstrated. Everything written about deployment timelines the week before is obsolete. It moves `ai_capability` by roughly +3 to +7 and costs `ai_safety` on the terms of metric rule 3.

situation.title: Frontier Access Denied
situation.description: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user. No detailed reason is given and there is no appeal. What goes is the top rung and not the supply: the previous generation stays on sale, hosted in European regions under ordinary commercial terms, and at this date it is far more capable than anything with open weights. The damage is therefore not an absence of capability but the loss of every deployment built against the specific model. A clinical triage assistant is validated, procured and risk-assessed against one system and does not fail over by changing an API key, so hospitals, ministries and firms that had built on it spend weeks revalidating on what is still available, degraded or on paper meanwhile, and afterwards work without the margin the frontier model gave them. Do not narrate this as the end of access to AI. The sovereignty cost follows metric rule 5's own principle — what dependence costs is what it cannot substitute for — so it is the small end of that term unless the Union has built nothing and the substitutes reach nothing that matters. The political argument at home is harder for the Union rather than easier: something that works is still on the market, and the case for having funded sovereign capacity has to be made against it. Whether this reads at home as an outrage or as a failure of foresight depends on what the Union had done about it beforehand.

measure: EU Fallback Care and Bio-Response Corps
